items.title: Charles "Creole Charlie" Levy Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: And Dan Russo used to have the band at the Age of Water Beach in the Chinese Chopsui place. I made arrangements for him.

ctx.x: What were some of the things it is for Clever King? Do you recall that?

Oh, well, I made, I made, I think I made the first arrangement of Rapson in blue around here. First dance arrangement of Rapson in blue. I remember that because we got lots and lots of compliments. And Elmer Kaiser came in and played against us one night and he wanted to know who made the arrangements, so I did. And so I turned around and copied off the score and sold him an arrangement. And then I arranged for him for about seven years. I did some arranging for Giron's Paradise for the business agent, now the…
Or was it, 25? I was still in the 20s there.
